scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
恭喜。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Heh...
It's tough
being a hero
and being shady,
untrustworthy,
sneaky...
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
嘿...
既要當英雄，又要鬼鬼祟祟、讓人信不過、偷偷摸摸...
真不容易啊。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
But when the
going gets rough
my pals know they
can count on me.
I need them and
they need me.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
不過，遇到難關，夥伴們都知道可以信賴我。
我需要他們，他們也需要我。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
This world needs
more heroes who are
willing to walk the line
between order and lawlessness.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
這個世界需要更多願意遊走在秩序與法外之間的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Are you ready
to join the ranks
of the sneakiest of
warriors? Are you ready
to become a Stalker?
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
準備好加入最擅長潛行的戰士行列了嗎？
你準備好成為神行太保了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Congratulations!
As a Stalker, I hope
you stab the right people
in the back. Banish the
wicked using their own
dastardly methods!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
恭喜！
願你身為神行太保，把背後的刀刺向該刺的人。
以惡人的卑鄙手段，除掉惡人！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向戰士們致敬！
